thread:
Mina (partnerships): Quick thread to finalize a simple SI co-sell handoff for mixed marketplace + HW bundles. Focus: claim windows, attribution, SKU mapping, and announcement gating. Short replies pls.
Carlos (sales): Sales asks: deterministic owner, a short soft-claim so deals don't stall, and clear AE crediting for marketplace-origin opportunities.
Yara (solutions): Suggestion: SI gets 48h soft-claim. If SI uploads a signed LOA or sets demo_lock, they get a 5-day exclusive window. demo_lock must include expires_at tz-aware.
Ben (marketplace): For private offers we need marketplace_offer_id + hw_bundle_code and a credited_partner_id in the export. Also add marketplace_origin boolean so SFDC mapping is trivial.
June (legal): Legal: LOA template + Partner Announcement Addendum ok. Recommend partner signoff window = 4 business days for announcements. Add logo usage checkbox in intake.
Mina (partnerships): Minimal intake fields: partner_tag, demo_lock, demo_expires_at, loa_url, claimed_until, marketplace_offer_id, hw_bundle_code, credited_partner_id. Example payload (webhook):
```json
{
  "lead_id": "L-2024-9000",
  "account_name": "North Ridge",
  "partner_tag": "si-aurora",
  "demo_lock": true,
  "demo_expires_at": "2024-06-15T18:00:00-07:00",
  "loa_url": "https://s3.redwood/loas/9000-signed.pdf",
  "claimed_until": "2024-06-20T18:00:00Z",
  "marketplace_offer_id": "gcp-private-2233",
  "hw_bundle_code": "NVIDIA-EDGE-PLUS",
  "credited_partner_id": "partner-omega"
}
```
Yara (solutions): Conflict resolution: priority = (valid signed LOA) > (demo_lock true + earlier lock_ts) > (first-claim timestamp) > (partner_tier). When conflict happens, post a short message in #partnerships with intake link and quick actions.
Carlos (sales): Attribution: marketplace-origin deals set sf_origin = marketplace_offer_id and credited_ae = assigned_ae. If AE doesn't engage within 24h of assignment, revert to partnerships queue. Also ask for an escalation rule: deals >= $350k flag Sales Ops + Partnerships.
Ben (marketplace): We'll add marketplace_offer_id, hw_bundle_code, and credited_partner_id to the daily export. marketplace_origin boolean included. ETA: 3 business days.
June (legal): I'll post LOA + Announcement Addendum drafts to Confluence and add the logo usage checkbox for intake.
intake-bot: Note: intake API will accept new optional fields. PR: https://github.com/redwood/integrations/pull/801
Mina (partnerships): Action items: Yara to formalize conflict logic + UX; Ben to update exports; Carlos to propose SFDC field names and attribution mapping; June to post legal templates; I'll stitch a 1-page playbook and schedule a 20-min walkthrough.
Carlos (sales): Can we sync tomorrow 11am PT? @Yara @June
Yara (solutions): I'm free.
June (legal): I'll be there.
Mina (partnerships): Meeting booked 11am PT. I'll drop playbook v0 before the call and include the intake webhook example. Thanks all :)
